name: Disneyland The Golden Horseshoe (Frontierland) Crispy Chicken Tenders or Mini Corn Dogs & Fries
whyItWorks: Air-conditioned indoor saloon seating in Frontierland serving white-meat chicken breast tenders and french fries with zero spicy seasoning.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Tenders (peel off thick breading edges if sensitive to fryer oil) with French fries or applesauce and honey mustard/ketchup on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the spicy buffalo/Nashville hot tenders when featured
